title: Get many AI opinions with this multi-AI tool — lifetime access is on sale for just $29.97
excerpt: Compare up to 6 responses side by side.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get lifetime AskAnyModel AI Pro access for a one-time $29.97 payment (reg. $499) through Oct. 25 with code SAVE10.

Credit: AskAnyModel

$29.97
$499 Save $469.03

The first AI answer isn’t automatically the most useful one. AskAnyModel AI Pro lifetime access is just $29.97 (reg. $499) through Oct. 25 with code SAVE10, giving you a way to compare responses instead of repeatedly copying your prompt into different tools.

The platform brings more than 50 AI models into one browser-based workspace, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, and others. Select two to six models, enter your prompt once, and view their answers side by side.

That comparison is useful when you’re weighing different approaches to a coding problem, looking for a stronger headline, or exploring a research question. You can review response times and token counts, too. Comparing answers helps you assess your options, though it doesn’t replace checking important facts.

The plan’s usage structure deserves attention. You get unlimited chats with 30 standard models, plus 500 monthly credits shared across 19 premium models. A separate Gemini model with Google Search grounding allows up to 300 chats per week. Lifetime access therefore doesn’t mean unlimited use of every model.

Mashable Trend Report

Image generation adds another practical benefit: you can create unlimited images across supported models without spending premium credits. And when a conversation needs a different approach, you can switch models without losing context.

There’s no software to install, and the model library receives ongoing updates. For writers, developers, and anyone who uses AI across different tasks, it’s nice to have several approaches available without managing separate interfaces.

One purchase gives you ongoing access, while the included monthly credits let you choose when to use premium models.

Get AskAnyModel AI Pro Lifetime for $29.97 with code SAVE10 through Oct. 25.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
